title: German Sweet Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional German dish featuring sweet potato dumplings in a light and fluffy texture.
instructions: Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, then mash.
In a large bowl, combine mashed sweet potatoes, flour, butter, eggs, salt, nutmeg, and unique spices.
Knead the dough until smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut into desired shapes, such as circles or squares.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Gently add the dumplings to the boiling water.
Cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the dumplings float to the surface.
Serve hot with your favorite sauce or dish.
